name: Atomix
abilities: Nucleokinesis - generates nuclear energy from his hands; the 'Nuclear Winner' blast knocks out enemies and devastates the surrounding area
Nuclear energy beams and radiokinesis (can even reproduce gamma radiation)
Ergokinesis / heat - activates arm cylinders and chest core to melt objects such as Ultimate Arachnachimp webbing
Photokinesis - 'Fusion Cuisine' orb of nuclear light that burns Ectonurites and badly harms Vladats, can persist after he reverts, and could theoretically be grown to the size of a sun
Flight via jet feet; 'Fissile Whistle' flying ram attack
Immense strength - one punch took out an Ultimate Vaxasaurian; kicked an object nearly out of a planet's atmosphere
Hard, durable body (substantial protection from physical attacks)
Focus chant ('HAA-MEE-NA HAA-MEE-NA...') substantially boosts attack power
weaknesses: Limited stamina - runs out of energy after heavy use and becomes exhausted (Malgax Attacks)
Boundlessly overconfident and can trigger a total meltdown
summary: A theatrical green-and-white nuclear knight who chants up atomic energy for planet-shaking punches, sun-bright light orbs and city-flattening blasts - Ben's second most powerful alien after Alien X.
traits: Adopts a formal, anime-hero persona and names his attacks (Nuclear Winner, Fissile Whistle, Fusion Cuisine)
Chant based on Goku's Kamehameha (also sounds like Ralph Kramden's 'homina homina')
Mouthless; Galvan-style symbol on his chest does not imply Galvan ties
First mentioned in the OS episode Ken 10 as one of Ben 10,000's aliens
Accidentally unlocked and named by Azmuth
notableFeats: Defeated Negative Ultimate Humungousaur with a single punch and Negative Ultimate Spidermonkey with the Nuclear Winner (For a Few Brains More)
Kicked an object almost out of Galvan Prime's atmosphere (For a Few Brains More)
Burned up Zs'Skayr and badly hurt Lord Transyl with a Fusion Cuisine light orb, leaving it active as a permanent ward over Z'Castle Zs'Skayr (The Vampire Strikes Back)
Broke into the Rooters' headquarters (Weapon XI: Part 1)
Fought Malgax until his stamina ran out (Malgax Attacks)

appearances.designNotes: Green-and-white robotic humanoid, large arm cylinders near the wrists filled with bubbling green energy, matching energy in his Omnitrix-shaped chest core and pointed armoured helmet, green eyes, no mouth; Omnitrix symbol on green/white belt.

scoring.rationale: Offense 9 and energy 9: one-punched Ultimate Humungousaur, flattened Ultimate Spidermonkey with the Nuclear Winner, and his Fusion Cuisine burned an Ectonurite out of existence with a light orb that could scale to a star. Durability 8 with a hard body that took Malgax's hits, plus flight. Raw nuclear power rather than reality-bending (cosmic 0), he tires after sustained output, his overconfidence risks a meltdown, and Malgax outlasted him - so he sits below Ultimate Way Big and Alien X.

notes: Derrick J. Wyatt calls Atomix Ben's second most powerful alien after Alien X and says his powers are largely unexplored.
OS: only mentioned in Ken 10 (Ben 10,000's roster; Ken wanted him) - no OS transformation, so no OS appearance despite the wiki category 'Ben 10,000's Transformations'.
The Omniverse Ben 10,000 used the Biomnitrix fusion Atomic-X (Atomix + Alien X) - separate record atomic-x.json.
Weapon XI: Part 1 use is an off-screen activation/cameo. Comics (Super Secret Crisis War!, The Worm That Turned) not counted.
A hypothetical Ultimate Atomix would need a containment suit like NRG's (Derrick J. Wyatt).
